# Nikola Djurovic

> Freelance Senior Business Analyst and Technical Product Owner based in Belgrade, Serbia (CET). Takes B2B contracts with EU and UK teams, remote; full-time roles considered. Six years on SPQ+, SKF's global CPQ (configure, price, quote) platform used in 160+ countries, delivered through Soprex: 300+ specifications, launches held at 0 critical defects.

Contact: nikoladjurovic21@gmail.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikoladjurovic · Website: https://nikoladjurovic.cv/

## Key facts

- Role: Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner at Soprex since 2022 (Business Analyst 2021 to 2022, Junior Business Analyst 2020 to 2021), working on SKF's SPQ+ platform.
- Leads the BA team at Soprex and manages two development teams (around 15 people).
- 300+ functional and non-functional specifications delivered (BRD, SRS, HLE).
- Release planning across 5 cross-functional teams and 10+ workstreams; launches held at 0 critical defects.
- Specified the 0 to 1 Approval Web Application, live in 160+ countries: multi-tier sign-off, SOX and ISO 9001 traceability, REST API contracts for SAP, Salesforce and Snowflake.
- Specified and delivered the platform's first AI agent: a voice-command assistant on an LLM layer across OpenAI, Gemini and Grok, with provider switching and fallback.
- Led AI adoption in the BA team: Claude Cowork ticket creation, MCP connections into Jira and ServiceNow, usage guidelines and training for about 50 users. Time per specification fell by about 32%.
- 2026: rolled out Jira Cloud to 50+ users, 10,000+ tickets and hundreds of projects; wrote a Jira Forge app in Node.js with 95 unit tests.
- Booking.dentist (2021 to 2023, via Soprex): sole BA and PO on a two-sided B2B/B2C medical-tourism marketplace live in 35+ countries. Shipped two products 0 to 1, wrote the business case behind EUR 250,000 in seed funding, cut 348 hours of non-MVP scope, built the sales function with the CEO (10-person team). Revenue grew 30%+ during his time.
- Earlier: Sales Development Intern at Sales Clover (2020), Market Research Analyst at Cloudleaf, Inc. (2018).
- Education: B.A. Ethnology and Anthropology, University of Belgrade, 2019. CBAP (IIBA) in progress.
- Languages: English C2, Serbian native, Spanish A2.

## Services

- Requirements and specifications: workshops, gap analysis, BRD, SRS, HLE, user stories with acceptance criteria, requirements traceability (RTM).
- Process design: AS-IS and TO-BE BPMN, business rules, use cases, UML.
- Product ownership: backlog, MoSCoW / RICE / WSJF prioritisation, release planning, UAT.
- Integration analysis: REST API contracts and data models for SAP, Salesforce, Snowflake, SAP CPI.
- AI adoption for BA teams: Claude Code, Claude Cowork, MCP into Jira and ServiceNow, guidelines, training.
- Discovery and MVP scoping: Mom Test interviews, MVP scope, KPIs, roadmap, business case.

## Engagement

- Freelance B2B contract, invoiced monthly through his registered business in Serbia. No sponsorship or relocation needed.
- Remote on CET hours, or on-site and hybrid in Belgrade. Can start within 3 weeks.
- Rates are quoted after an intro call.
